scope: Native durable document-extraction queue intake: atomic enqueue + immutable outbox, scoped recovery and explicit cancellation, surviving process restart and restore. Bounded pre-execution lifecycle only; no external dispatch or OCR provider activation.
requirements: Read AGENTS/persistence-contracts and existing native intake/extraction interfaces. Work only ledgerpoint-jobs on exact base, within P03-02 file lease. Root approves this additive disposable-only persistence interface subject to independent final review.

Expose a real company/source-scoped native enqueue/recover/cancel service and appropriate routes using existing authentication and response conventions. Enqueue is an explicit request, never automatic on upload/startup. Native response must clearly say execution unavailable/not connected; existing OCR/email providerStatus remains not_connected. No arbitrary command/URL resolution or provider call, no scheduler startup.

Preserve document-intake.extraction-job.v1 identity, source hash/revision, recipe fingerprint, UUID request, actor/company binding and max_attempts. Use existing createExtractionJob/cancelJob, never cast deserialized JSON into WeakSet-branded objects. Implement strict versioned queued/cancelled persistence reconstruction from freshly verified native source bytes and immutable records; reject malformed, mismatched or future/unsupported state/version. Do not pretend in-flight/finished worker snapshots are supported.

Add durable-jobs.review.sql only; keep existing pinned SQL byte-identical. Suggested append-only durable_jobs identity + durable_job_events lifecycle + durable_outbox records for queued/cancelled revisions. Do not label enqueue rows execution attempts; durable_job_attempts/dispatch leases remain future work. Tenant-composite FKs/keys, unique request identity, exact hashes/version/revision constraints, immutable UPDATE/DELETE/TRUNCATE ALWAYS guards, restricted SELECT/INSERT grants. No runtime DDL/migration application to existing database.

Enqueue atomically writes identity, queued lifecycle event and dispatch-notification outbox. Same company/request replay returns original state; changed source/actor/recipe/policy/revision is conflict/denial. Fence multiple unresolved jobs per source if existing reference semantics require it. Cancellation atomically appends one terminal event/outbox; replay never requeues. Preserve source bytes and original audit; no financial posting, supplier/tax decisions or document conversion.

Recheck current active membership and native intake read/manage rights for every action, lock company/member/source/job in consistent actual native order, verify source bytes/hash/revision and unconverted source eligibility. Removed member/crosscompany/corrupt/changed/converted evidence fails closed; do not leak raw SQL/payload/errors. Metadata/history may remain retained even when action blocked.

Required migration/history registration and both disposable installer modes; absent/partial schema must fail safely before writes and leave existing intake available. Use already owned tools/accounting-flow/test.mjs to register new native integration and restored read tests. Avoid editing unowned workflow/other suites.

Native tests: duplicate enqueue/concurrent enqueue and request mismatch; explicit cancel+replay; transaction rollback after each write boundary; read-only/crosscompany/removed member and source mutation/conversion; immutable SQL grants/guards; actual subprocess death after commit and fresh-process recovery with same request; populated restored queued/cancelled identities/outbox through native restricted role. Test only real PostgreSQL in existing disposable CI, not mocks claimed as persistence proof.

No external adapters, credential/provider connections, execution claims, retries, physical-capacity reclamation, transport settlement, scheduler or financial effects in this bounded outcome. Full P03-02 remains pending validated in-flight/result rehydration, durable worker leases/attempts and safely fenced outbox dispatch. State this precisely in service docs/report.

Run focused pure/route tests (existing plus new), registry tests and compile native integration/restart/restore harness from exact worktree before commit. Local PostgreSQL unavailable; do not bypass. Root runs combined/build and existing full GitHub CI after independent review; author does not self-approve or publish.

Commit locally using LedgerPoint development identity, no attribution trailer; save compact author report/logs under run-20261117-durable-intake, confirm clean/stopped by target or earlier. No queue edits, remote refs, merge/deploy/demo/shared DB changes.
